verdict.rationale: Summer Engine documents a CLI that an agent can use to run the full publishing flow, and llms.txt says any agent can build, test and publish a game. This is a first-party scriptable surface that could support automation. However, nothing in the evidence documents a headless mode, CI integration or non-interactive builds. The `--dry-run`/`--print` flags only preview agent-config setup, so they are not evidence of headless operation. Missing for 10: documented headless/no-GUI execution, CI pipeline examples or integrations, non-interactive build/test/export commands, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Your agent runs the whole publishing flow on Summer Games through the MCP or CLI.
Any agent builds, tests and publishes a full multiplayer game
`--cli` installs the skills with no MCP server.
